examples.text: Se munuc sealde ðæs cuman suna męte.
examples.translation: The monk gave food to the stranger’s son.
examples.target: Nested dependent genitive within a dative recipient phrase.
Dative person and genitive thing denied.
Invariant quantity word plus genitive plural.

examples.text: Ān ðāra munuca cōm tō ðǣm hūse.
examples.translation: One of the monks came to the house.
examples.target: Substantival one with genitive whole; destination dative.
The governed dative is not an accusative direct object.

examples.text: Sēo gāt is ðǣm scēaphierde behēfu.
examples.translation: The goat is useful to the shepherd.
examples.target: Dative after useful with independent subject agreement.
Dative experiencer with a neuter nominative subject and agreeing predicate.
Accusative experiencer with a third-singular impersonal verb.

examples.text: Se munuc cōm mid ðǣm cuman.
examples.translation: The monk came with the stranger.

examples.text: Se munuc fēdde ðone cuman mid gōdum męte.
examples.translation: The monk fed the stranger with good food.

examples.text: Se munuc fēdde ðone cuman gōde męte.
examples.translation: The monk fed the stranger with good food.
examples.target: Bare instrumental means with a distinct strong-adjective form.

examples.text: Se munuc fēdde ðone cuman ðȳ męte.
examples.translation: The monk fed the stranger with that food.
examples.target: Distinct instrumental determiner; the noun has the dative-shaped ending.
An adjective describing the perceived object agrees with it.
A weak plural adjective names the people described.

compositions.title: The stranger and the monk
compositions.text: Sum cuma cōm tō ðǣm giesthūse. Hine hyngrede, and hē wæs untrum. Ān ðāra munuca geseah ðone cuman. Se munuc sealde him męte and wæter. Se cuma cwæð: “Ðū ne forwiernst mē mętes.” Se munuc cwæð: “Ic fēde ðē gōde męte.” Se cuma ǣt ðone męte and dranc ðæt wæter.
compositions.target: Connected relief of hunger: impersonal experience, partitive identification, a gift, denial contrast and instrumental means. No private full translation is included.
compositions.support_policy: All required lexical senses, forms and constructions must be productive before this independent reading.
